gallery.title: File:Glasgow Cathedral - geograph.org.uk - 10200.jpg
gallery.description: Glasgow Cathedral. Christians have worshiped at this site since  the 5th century but little is known about the church buildings until the early part of the 12th century, when an earlier cathedral was replaced by one consecrated in 1197.  Most of the Nave probably dates from after 1330.  St Mungo is buried in the cathedral.
